definition.content:
## KrakenD Overview

This dashboard contains an overview of your KrakenD API Gateway. The dashboard is split in groups for the Global, Proxy and Backend Layer. Metrics are collected using the KarkenD Prometheus exporter.

### Further Reading
- [Datadog KrakenD Integration Documentation]()
- [KrakenD Prometheus Exporter](https://www.krakend.io/docs/telemetry/opentelemetry/#prometheus-exporter-pull)
- [KrakenD Layers and Metrics](https://www.krakend.io/docs/telemetry/opentelemetry-layers-metrics/)
- [KarkenD Logs Overview](https://www.krakend.io/docs/logging/)

definition.title: Number of backend requests by status

definition.content:
Number of requests sent to the backend service by reported status:

- **Completed**: number of request completed successfully.
- **Cancelled**: number of requests cancelled by the user before completion
- **Timed Out**: number of requests where the backend timed out.
- **Failed**: number of requests that failed (excluding time outs and cancellations).
- **Started**: the total number of requests started.

definition.title: Requests rate sent to each backend route

definition.content:
This graph shows the number of requests per second emitted by the backend http client to each each backend url route.

The backend route is the one defined as the url pattern in each backend endpoint of the KrakenD configuration.

A breakdown of the average latency when KrakenD communicates with a backend service.

-   **Connection Latency**: Time spent establishing the connection to the backend service.
-   **DNS Latency**: Latency from DNS resolution, if required.
-   **TLS Latency**: Latency from TLS negotiation, if required.
-   **Backend Latency**: Time the backend service takes to serve the request.
-   **Response Read Time**: Time spent reading the response from the backend.
